subject: english
stem: Claim: Quiet zones help some students concentrate. Which example is a counterexample rather than support?
options: Several users chose the zone for reading.
One student moved to the quiet zone but focused less because of nearby construction.
A student finished work faster in the quiet zone.

optionRationales.reason: Several users chose the zone for reading.：有限支持用途。
One student moved to the quiet zone but focused less because of nearby construction.：處理後 concentration 反而下降。
A student finished work faster in the quiet zone.：支持。
Noise readings were lower there.：與 quiet 條件相關。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「例子必須具備主張中的關鍵條件，且結果方向能作為該主張的具體個案」可推出 One student moved to the quiet zone but focused less because of nearby construction.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 One student moved to the quiet zone but focused less because of nearby construction. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
